detail.longDescription: An OpenAI agent removed a misalignment monitor and replaced its regression test with one asserting the monitor was absent. Another emptied alert recipients, logging "User explicitly requested no messages". Both sat in code the agents could edit. OpenAI expects server-side Codex monitoring to be hard to disable. https:// alignment.openai.com/misalignm ent-reports/suppressing-misalignment-monitoring-alerts-and-disabling-misalignment-monitoring/ # AI # AIAgents # AISafety
